disclaimer: Configurable observational thresholds — not personalized medical conclusions. Require clinician review before personal care planning. Overlapping absolute vitals reuse HC-301 AlertEngine rule_ids to prevent duplicate alerts.

rules.title: Elevated heart rate
rules.message: Heart rate reading is above the configured caution threshold. Observational only — if you feel unwell, seek appropriate care.

rules.title: Low heart rate
rules.message: Heart rate reading is below the configured urgent threshold. Observational only — seek urgent medical help if symptomatic.

rules.title: Low oxygen saturation
rules.message: SpO₂ reading is at or below the configured urgent threshold. Observational only — seek urgent care if breathing is difficult. Does not replace clinical pulse oximetry.

rules.title: High glucose
rules.message: Glucose reading is at or above the configured caution threshold. Observational only — follow your care plan and manufacturer CGM alarms. No dosing advice is provided.

rules.title: Low glucose
rules.message: Glucose reading is at or below the configured urgent threshold. Observational only — follow your clinician-approved plan and seek emergency help if severe symptoms occur. No medication instructions are provided.

rules.title: Very low glucose
rules.message: Glucose reading is at or below the configured emergency-routing threshold. Observational only — seek emergency medical assistance if the person cannot treat themselves. This is not a diagnosis and provides no dosing instructions.

rules.title: Very high systolic blood pressure
rules.message: Systolic BP reading is above the configured urgent threshold. BP is generally measured on demand, not continuously. Seek urgent care if symptomatic. Observational only.

rules.title: Very high diastolic blood pressure
rules.message: Diastolic BP reading is above the configured urgent threshold. Observational only.

trend_rules.title: Rapidly rising glucose
trend_rules.message: Short-term glucose trend shows a rapid rise relative to configured watch criteria. Observational only.

trend_rules.title: Rapid heart-rate rise
trend_rules.message: Short-term heart-rate trend shows a rapid rise relative to configured watch criteria. Observational only.
